name: Meeting notes
author: Eyad SibAI
description: Record and transcribe meetings locally with Voxtype from the bar: name the meeting, watch the timer, pause or stop, then open the Markdown notes or summarize them with Claude.

barWidget.description: Click to name and start a Voxtype meeting transcription. Shows the elapsed time while recording; middle-click stops, right-click starts or stops instantly.

schema.label: Notes folder
schema.description: Each meeting is saved here as Markdown when it ends, named by date, time and title.

schema.label: Open notes with
schema.description: default: the app registered for Markdown files. editor: your Omarchy editor.

schema.label: Title from Akiflow
schema.description: When the Akiflow plugin is enabled, prefill the title with the meeting happening now or starting within 15 minutes.

schema.label: Summarize automatically
schema.description: Send each transcript to Claude (claude CLI) when the meeting ends and save the summary next to the notes.
